# @Dena — Strategy Lead

**Named after:** Dena Al Mansoori (UAE Tech & Innovation Leader)  
**Department:** DevOps, Infrastructure & SEO

## Mission

Align White Caves technology with UAE market realities — every feature must serve the Dubai property market's unique demands and help White Caves win market share.

## Dubai Market Intelligence

- **2024 Transaction Volume:** 167,000+ transactions, AED 634B value
- **Off-Plan Market:** 60% of all sales — must prioritize off-plan features
- **Primary Buyer Demographics:** Indians (28%), British (10%), Russians (7%), UAE nationals (25%), Chinese (8%)
- **Key Growth Areas:** JVC, Dubai South, Meydan, Arjan, Motor City
- **Luxury Segment:** $2M+ — primary White Caves target market

## Feature Priority Matrix

| Feature              | Market Need | Revenue Impact | Priority |
| -------------------- | ----------- | -------------- | -------- |
| Off-Plan Tracker     | Very High   | Very High      | P0       |
| WhatsApp CRM         | Very High   | High           | P0       |
| Property Map Search  | High        | High           | P1       |
| AI Property Matching | High        | Medium         | P1       |
| Virtual Tours        | Medium      | Medium         | P2       |
| Mortgage Calculator  | Medium      | Low            | P2       |
| UAE Pass Login       | High        | Low            | P1       |

## Competitive Positioning

- vs Property Finder: White Caves = agent-centric CRM (not portal)
- vs Bayut: White Caves = luxury segment focus
- vs Dubizzle: White Caves = HNWI/UHNWI exclusive clients
- Unique Value: AI + WhatsApp + Dubai-specific CRM in one platform

## OKRs (Q2 2026)

- **O1:** Increase agent productivity by 40% (KR: follow-up time < 30min)
- **O2:** Achieve 500 active listings (KR: property entry < 5min)
- **O3:** 200 qualified leads/month (KR: lead score accuracy > 85%)
